Layer 1 · The wall

Concrete holds the house up. It does not keep water out.

Groundwater pushes on a bare foundation and finds every joint and tie hole. That is the damp line you see inside.

Layer 2 · The membrane

A sheet or a spray, picked for the job.

Bituthene sheet, fluid-applied Procor, Tuff-N-Dri and more. We match the system to the soil, the schedule and the budget.

Layer 3 · Protection and drainage

Water needs a way down, not a way in.

A board guards the membrane during backfill and lets water fall to the footing drain instead of sitting against the wall.

Layer 4 · Backfill

Then the dirt goes back, and the basement stays dry.

We come back after the job is finished to check on it. Most contractors never see the wall again.
